title: Split a file in pieces
summary: Write a file as several smaller files of N lines each, named FILE.part1, FILE.part2...
hints: Keep the output `FILE *` and a line counter: open a new piece (`snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%s.part%d", ...)`) only when you have a line to write and no piece is open.
After writing N lines close the piece and print its summary. When the input ends, close the last piece if there is one open.
